estimates: The model represents the standing nineteenth-century church and garden, whose documented identity survives on this site. The Qualla illustration is of the medieval building.
The native survey establishes the building envelope and yard. Roof pitch and divisions, door and window placements, colors and the minor ironwork are reconstructed estimates.
The bell frame follows the 1947 description. Its present form and exact garden position are uncertain. Interior spring, paintings, fixtures and sculptures are outside the modeled exterior.

review.notes: Reviewed the exact Qualla medieval original first. Its drawing represents the predecessor. The supplemental candidate exterior has conflicting licensing and the 1877 print is an interior. The model uses the mapped geometry and firsthand exterior descriptions.
